_meta.purpose: The two lookup facts that need an outside source before they can be stated: which network a Jordanian mobile prefix belongs to, and how much abuse a domain extension carries.
_meta.rule: Both lists ship verified: false, so the Jordan layer omits those rows and the screen says nothing rather than guessing. The endpoint is already wired to them: flipping a flag to true is all it takes to turn the row on.
_meta.owner: Abdelrahman. The prefix map needs the TRC's published allocation; the extension list needs a named abuse report to cite.

operator_prefixes.source_needed: Telecommunications Regulatory Commission published mobile number allocation

tld_risk.source_needed: A named, dated abuse report — e.g. Spamhaus or Interisle — that ranks these extensions
